title: Labels
description: Create the markers you attach to files and folders. Whatever you create here becomes a choice when labelling.
empty: No labels yet. Create one below and you can attach it to files and folders.
delete_confirm: Delete “{name}”. It will also come off the files and folders it is attached to. Are you sure?
system_hint: System labels cannot be deleted (you can still change the name and colour).
error_duplicate: A label with that name already exists
error_duplicate_trashed: A label with that name is in Trash. Restore it, or delete it permanently from Trash.
error_forbidden: You do not have permission to do this
error_not_found: That label no longer exists. It may have been deleted elsewhere.
error_network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
